tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new mock REST API project. Returns {id, adminKey, baseUrl, resources[]}. SAVE the adminKey — it is required for admin operations (add_resource, custom_route, snapshots) and is shown only once. Presets seed a full multi-resource backend: blog (posts/comments/authors), ecommerce (products/ord

tools.name: import_data
tools.description: Create a live mock API from existing artifacts. Auto-detects: OpenAPI 3.x / Swagger 2.0 spec (JSON or YAML) → resources with realistic seeded data; json-server db.json → hosts your exact records; Postman Collection v2.x → resources from requests, saved example responses become records verbatim; CSV/

tools.name: add_resource
tools.description: Add a resource (collection) to a project and seed it with realistic fake data. Either pass template (one of the built-ins, e.g. users, products, posts, comments, orders, todos, reviews, customers, events) or fields: an array of {name, type} where type ∈ uuid|firstName|lastName|fullName|username|emai

tools.name: project_info
tools.description: Get a project's public root index: every resource with record counts and URLs, custom routes, auth mode, and export links (openapi.json, types.ts, postman.json, db.json, GraphQL). No adminKey needed. Try project "demo" for the shared public playground.

tools.name: query_records
tools.description: GET records from a mock resource. params is an object of query parameters, all optional: exact filters (field=value), operator suffixes (price_gte, date_lte, name_like, status_ne), full-text q, _sort/_order (or _page/_limit for pagination), select (field projection, e.g. "name,price"), _expand=<pare

tools.name: write_record
tools.description: Create, update, or delete records in a mock resource. Writes persist (unlike JSONPlaceholder/FakeStoreAPI). POST creates (auto-id), PUT replaces, PATCH merges, DELETE removes. id required for PUT/PATCH/DELETE.

tools.name: custom_route
tools.description: Define a custom endpoint on a project (like /health, /config/:key, or a catch-all /webhooks/* request bin). body is a response template: {{query.x}} {{params.x}} {{body.x}} {{headers.x}} {{method}} {{path}} {{now}} {{ts}} {{uuid}} {{rand}}; triple braces {{{body}}} insert raw JSON. tools.name: snapshots
tools.description: Deterministic test fixtures: save the project's entire dataset under a name, restore it exactly later (list/delete too). Any GET can also be served read-only FROM a snapshot without touching live data via query param mock_snapshot=<name> in query_records params — parallel test scenarios on one proje

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_project, project_info · Private data: import_data, add_resource, project_info, query_records, write_record · Public sink: create_project, add_resource, write_record · Destructive: create_project, write_record, snapshots.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_project, project_info · Private data: import_data, add_resource, project_info, query_records, write_record · Public sink: create_project, add_resource, write_record · Destructive: create_project, write_record, snapshots

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
